facts.fact: Sendai Castle, also called Aoba Castle, was built by Date Masamune.
facts.excerpt: Sendai Castle (or Aoba Castle) was built by Date Masamune.

facts.fact: The city explicitly describes carefully reconstructed stone walls; the site should not be sold as an intact original castle palace.
facts.excerpt: The stone walls have been carefully reconstructed

facts.fact: The site includes an equestrian Date Masamune monument overlooking the city and a separate Aoba Castle Museum.
facts.excerpt: The Aoba Castle Museum is also located here.

facts.fact: The official address is 1 Kawauchi, Aoba-ku, Sendai.

title: City of Sendai — Site of Sendai Castle
